evidence.limits: whisper.srt not available at coding time; the Reel is a rapid-fire 'this or that' game where captions show the host's questions (white) and his one-word answers (large yellow); answers are read from captions only. The caption does not say which of his choices were real answers versus the checkmark graphic. Final sentence at 48 to 52 s partly cut by 1 fps sampling. Speech fields checked against the transcript on 09 Nov 2026 (text-only pass).

topic_detail: Podcast host Tali Ziskin puts Matan through a 60-second 'this or that' lightning round (love sex or lust sex, rich and lonely or poor with real friends, etc.) with a countdown timer; the picks are shown with graphics.
audience: viewers of the 'אמת בפרצוף' podcast, adult followers interested in relationships and money
caption_vs_video_note: Caption describes a full podcast episode about relationships, love, attraction and business; the Reel itself is only the lightning-round game, not those topics. The Reel is posted by the host's account (collab with boidem_studio and the host).

opening.first_frame: The woman host at a desk with a laptop and mug, a retro TV behind her, looking down at the laptop and speaking; no text.
opening.s0_1: Caption 'סקס של אהבה?' appears at 0.25 s on the host; no cut yet.
opening.s1_3: Caption changes to 'סקס של תשוקה?' (1.25 s); at 2.25 s a cut to Matan in profile with a green 60-second timer (58) over his chest.
opening.s3_5: Back to the host with 'כסף' then 'או', a money confetti overlay and a stock picture of a person with open arms; cut to Matan 'אושר?' (4 s) with a green tick.
opening.visual_hook: A fast alternating game with a timer, a question, and a stock picture next to each option.
opening.spoken_hook: The host speaks from 0 s: 'סקס של אהבה או סקס של תשוקה?' (machine transcript, 0 to 2 s), then 'כסף או אושר?' at 3 s and his answer 'אושר' at 4.5 s.
opening.text_hook: סקס של אהבה? / סקס של תשוקה?
opening.payoff_promised_at_s: about 2 s (the timer implies the game ends at 0)
opening.first_sentence_standalone: yes: the first caption is a self-contained question
opening.number_or_money_in_first_3s: yes (timer '58' from 2.25 s; the word 'כסף' at 3.25 s)
opening.works_without_sound: yes: the questions are captioned and the picks appear as big words

visual.subject_placement: Alternating front-facing shots of the host (left, laptop) and Matan (in profile, microphone at the right); captions at about 45% height; timer at about 60%.
visual.setting: Podcast studio: red wall with an old television for the host, beige wall and plant for the guest.
visual.lighting: Soft studio light, warm on the host's side.
visual.color_contrast: Red wall and white clothing for the host, black shirt against beige for Matan; yellow captions; the timer ring turns green, then yellow, then orange, then red.
visual.props_and_gestures: Laptop and a mug with the podcast name, host typing and gesturing; Matan with closed eyes thinking, grimacing, laughing at 36 s.
visual.supporting_footage: Stock photos next to each option (a person with open arms, a couple, models, an actor on a jet, an Africa-aid photo), a short clip of a man at a laptop, money bills falling over the shot (31 to 33 s), a 3D globe set at 34 to 36 s, a business certificate image and a man with head in hand, phone with a heart (pick-up) at 46 to 47 s, and a WOW sticker at 15 s.
visual.persistent_branding: Small logo of the host's podcast at the top right from 48 s.
visual.visual_progression: 0 to 2 s host; 2 to 50 s cuts between host (question) and Matan (answer) every 1 to 4 s with a countdown timer from 60 to 0 and a stock picture for each option; 48 to 50 s host speaks again with 'היה לי כיף לשמוע את התשובות שלך'; 51 to 53 s Matan answers 'היה לי כיף עם השאלון הזה'.
visual.cover_matches_video: yes: cover is the guest frame with the large word 'אהבה' and the timer, from 5 to 6 s.
visual.ui_interference: Timer and captions at about 45 to 65% height, clear of the top 14%; small podcast logo top right only at the end.

editing.edit_function: Information and stimulation: every pair of options has two stock pictures that illustrate them, ticks mark the choice, and the timer builds pressure.
pacing_changes: t=2 to 48s: a cut every 1 to 3 s, in step with questions
t=30 to 36s: money and globe overlays make the picture busiest
t=48 to 53s: slower back-and-forth, no timer
editing.ending: Host says it was fun to hear his answers; Matan says it was fun with this questionnaire (48 to 52 s).
editing.rewatch_reasons: Interpretation: the timer and the quick answers invite replaying to catch his picks, but the text does not point to the full episode on screen.

sound.delivery: Interpretation: continuous speech at about -20 to -33 dB with no silent gap; quick back-and-forth with one-word answers, short laughs.
sound.sfx: inferred: whoosh and tick sounds for ticks and the 'WOW' sticker, a ticking timer sound is likely but not determinable
sound.sync: The timer counts down second by second (58 to 01) and each cut lands on a new question or answer, so text, picture and speech are tightly aligned.

text.colour_coding: Host's questions in small white or yellow-outlined text; Matan's answers as large bold yellow words ('אושר', 'מונוגמיה', 'שחורדינית', 'רזה', 'מעסק', 'PICK-UP'); timer ring changes colour with the time left.
text.placement: Centre of frame at about 45% height, timer below at about 60%, stock pictures in the lower third.
text.style: Yellow Hebrew sans-serif with black outline; two sizes (question small, answer large); English 'PICK-UP' in capitals.
text.density_and_read_time: 2 to 6 words per caption, changing every 1 to 2 s; easy.
text.language: Short either-or questions, no full sentences: 'שחורדינית או בלונדינית', 'רזה או מלאה', 'כדור הארץ שטוח או עגול?'. Close: 'היה לי כיף עם השאלון הזה'.
text.caption_structure: Long: host says she invited him to her podcast 'אמת בפרצוף' (Spotify only), lists topics (couple life, love, attraction, business, employees, millionaire mindset), and tells viewers to search for the full episode on Spotify.
text.rtl_notes: Hebrew RTL correct; English word 'PICK-UP' and the digits of the timer sit correctly; question marks follow the Hebrew.

story.setup: A 60-second lightning questionnaire of either-or questions to the guest.
story.stakes: The timer runs out in 60 seconds.
story.progression: About 15 questions, from love versus lust to rich-and-lonely versus poor-with-friends, a flat or round earth, start a business you do not love, down to a PICK-UP question.
story.payoff: His picks, notably the controversial 'עשיר ובודד' answer at 22 s (rich and alone).
friction_points: t=0 to 2s: two questions before the timer starts (interpretation: clear)
t=30 to 36s: money and globe overlays cover the faces (interpretation)
episode is only on Spotify, which several commenters resent

engagement.comment_notes: Sample of 35 comments, not representative. Most react to his 'עשיר ובודד' pick ('עצוב', 'שום כסף לא יכול לקנות חברים אמיתיים', 'עשיר ובודד? חרטא'); others joke ('הארץ היא שטוחה'), ask whether the episode is on YouTube ('שונאת ספוטיפיי'), and ask about the stutter ('למה מגמגם').

conversion.offer: The full podcast episode on Spotify only.
conversion.benefit: A longer conversation about couples, love, attraction, business and mindset.
conversion.funnel_entry_visible: none in the video (the Spotify mention is in the caption)
conversion.cta_fits_content: partly: the game is not the topics listed in the caption
conversion.destination: Spotify podcast 'אמת בפרצוף' with Tali Ziskin; link not visible, only named

pair_match.notes: n/a (top Reel, no pair in dossier)

rights_and_privacy: The footage belongs to the host's podcast (collab post); stock photos of identifiable models and an actor, a couple under blankets and a charity scene are inserted; no bystanders.
why_it_may_work: Interpretation: a game format with a visible countdown, one-word answers and a stock picture per option is easy to read and rewatch; his 'rich and lonely' pick triggers comment debate and shares (415).
why_it_may_underperform: Interpretation: the caption's real topic (the full episode) is not shown; Spotify-only link frustrates some; heavy overlays.

standout_moments.what: Green 60-second timer appears on Matan, turning the Q and A into a game
His answer 'עשיר ובודד' (large yellow caption), the pick most commented on
Money bills fall across the host when she asks about income sources
'PICK-UP' with a phone-heart graphic at the final question
